pages.title: Pack for the journey
pages.text: Bring a pickaxe, food, armor, weapons, blocks and free inventory space. Make extra Ariente Pearls for locating and charging an entrance.$(br2)Your first goals are a safe return route, useful minerals and populated blueprints. Mark the arrival Warper’s position before venturing out.

pages.title: A rewarding route
pages.text: $(li)Find an Overworld entrance with a Pearl.$(li)Charge its Warper and travel.$(li)Scout smaller complexes first.$(li)Collect blueprints and materials.$(li)Use your Constructor to build a workshop.$(li)Improve equipment before tackling larger cities.$(br2)Use the Ariente chapter for machine setup and equipment controls.
